name: My Best Buy® Visa® Card
effective_cost: Free for most cardholders: the annual fee is $0 to $59, based on creditworthiness
variable_apr: Variable 14.49%-30.99%, or non-variable 9.00%-20.24%, based on creditworthiness
balance_transfer_apr: Variable 14.49%-30.99%, or non-variable 9.00%-20.24%, based on creditworthiness
balance_transfer_fee: The greater of $15 or 5% of the amount of each transfer

welcome_bonus.bonus: 10% back in rewards on your first day of purchases at Best Buy
welcome_bonus.requirement: your first day of purchases with Standard Credit within 14 days of account opening; first-time approvals only, can't be combined with other offers, excludes tax

verdict.text: Only worth it for regular Best Buy shoppers: rewards are store-locked

earn_rates.category: Best Buy purchases (in-store, BestBuy.com & the app): 6% with a paid My Best Buy Plus or Total membership

earn_note: This is the open-loop Visa version of Best Buy's card: it earns outside Best Buy, unlike the closed-loop, store-only My Best Buy Credit Card, which earns 5% at Best Buy but nothing anywhere else. Rewards are earned only when you choose Standard Credit at checkout, so taking promotional financing on a purchase forfeits its rewards. The extra 1% that makes 6% comes from a paid My Best Buy Plus or Total membership, not from the card. Best Buy periodically runs limited-time bonus categories.

redemption_options.method: Best Buy / BestBuy.com reward certificates, plus a published list of third-party gift cards through the My Best Buy rewards portal

points.per_100k: $2,000 in Best Buy certificates (250 points = a $5 certificate)
points.note: Despite the open-loop Visa network letting you earn everywhere, redemption is closed-loop: rewards come back as Best Buy certificates or partner e-gift cards, never cash or a statement credit. Certificates typically expire 60 days after they're issued.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: My Best Buy Rewards redeem only at Best Buy or through its fixed gift-card catalog.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's public product page for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's public product page for this card

protection_note: Citi and Best Buy's pages for this card don't list purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance, and no Guide to Benefits for this card was found. Treat it as a rewards-and-financing card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

status_perks.name: Keeps My Best Buy membership active
status_perks.note: An open My Best Buy Credit Card account keeps your My Best Buy membership active. Best Buy's free Elite and Elite Plus tiers no longer exist; the paid Plus and Total memberships add the extra 1%.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: Deferred-interest financing on qualifying Best Buy purchases: 12 months on $299 and up, with longer terms during promotions. Interest is charged from the purchase date if the balance isn't paid in full in time, and financed purchases earn no rewards.

services.name: Annual fee based on creditworthiness
services.detail: Citi sets the annual fee at $0 to $59 based on creditworthiness, so check the fee in your offer before accepting.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's Best Buy and gas/grocery spend toward one annual certificate pool.

timeline.text: Best Buy/Citi issue two distinct card products under similar names: the closed-loop, store-only My Best Buy Credit Card (5% at Best Buy, unusable elsewhere) and this open-loop My Best Buy Visa Card (5% at Best Buy plus 1–3% elsewhere). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card with different names.
